title: Boss: The Leaky Wallet
story: A wallet class forgets its cash and refuses to spend every last rupee. Two bugs hide inside.
goal: Fix Wallet so cash is stored, and spending exactly all the cash works.
hints: The first bug is in __init__: assigning to plain cash creates a local variable that vanishes.
The second bug is a comparison: is spending exactly all the cash allowed? Check >= against >.
socratic: What is the difference between cash and self.cash?
Should spending exactly all your cash be allowed?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
